messages:
Alyssa: Quick thread — ran a focused triptych across L4 / T4 / A10G for embeddings (short vectors) and small-chat (~256 tokens). Regions: us-west1, us-east4, eu-west1. Attaching raw CSV: https://gcs.redwood.internal/buckets/bench/triptych/1976543210.csv

bench-bot: sweep started 1976543210 — total runs 180

Sam: Topline: A10G shows lowest latency by ~20–35% on small-chat 256 tokens, but cost-per-token ~2.1x vs T4 for embeddings.

Vikram: Numbers? paste the highlights pls.

Alyssa: paste below (median/p95/throughput/cost ballpark):
```
# small-chat (256 tokens) median p95 latency (ms) / throughput (req/s) / cost ($/1M tokens)
A10G us-west1  : p50 85ms  p95 210ms  120 req/s  cost 0.018
T4  us-west1   : p50 130ms p95 340ms  75  req/s  cost 0.0085
L4  us-west1   : p50 95ms  p95 230ms  110 req/s  cost 0.012
```

Meera: Interesting — L4 sits between T4 and A10G cost-wise but approaches A10G latency for this token length. What about embeddings?

Alyssa: embeddings numbers: 
```
# embeddings median latency (ms) / qps / cost ($/1M vectors)
A10G us-west1  : 6ms   1400 qps  cost 0.022
T4  us-west1   : 9ms   900  qps  cost 0.009
L4  us-west1   : 7ms   1200 qps  cost 0.015
```

Jonah: kernel choices — were these runs using fused_attention or default transformer kernels?

Vikram: On A10G we turned on fused attention + cuDNN where supported. L4 runs used Triton custom matmul + int8 quant for a subset (embeddings). T4 mostly nvfuser fallback kernels.

Alyssa: also ran quant sweep: 8-bit on L4 reduced memory ~28% with ~1–2% quality drop for small-chat; embeddings quality ~unchanged.

Sam: So recommendation for prod defaults?

Meera: For embeddings-heavy workloads: T4 gives best cost per vector at scale, unless you need ultra low tail latency — choose A10G. For small-chat @256 tokens: L4 is the pragmatic default (balance); pick A10G if you have strict p95 <200ms SLO.

Alyssa: capacity guidance (rough per-GPU concurrency for small-chat 256 tokens, mix chat:embed = 70:30):
```
A10G: ~20 concurrent sessions / GPU
L4  : ~14 concurrent sessions / GPU
T4  : ~9  concurrent sessions / GPU
```

Vikram: caveat — region differences were small for median, but eu-west p95 on A10G was ~10–12% worse due to NVLink topology + instance placement variance. Spot availability also changes effective cost.

Sam: Any quality regressions flagged after quantization?

Alyssa: Ran eval set (2k prompts). L4 int8 small-chat: BLEU-like metric dropped ~1.6% absolute; flagged 12 prompts with increased hallucination rates — adding to regression dashboard. Embeddings: negligible drift.

bench-bot: sweep complete 1976543870 — artifacts: gs://bench/triptych/1976543210/ (summary.csv, raw-logs.tar.gz, plots/)

Meera: Action items: 1) add A10G as an optional tier in Dedicated SKU deck, 2) create quant-8 profile for L4 for embeddings path, 3) update docs w/ cost examples + capacity tables. I'll file tickets.

Jonah: +1 — also suggest we validate seq512 behaviour next (potential memory cliff).

Sam: thanks team — neat quick pass. @Alyssa can you drop CSV + a 1-slide summary in eng-ml drive?

Alyssa: done — slide: https://docs.redwood.internal/d/1a2b3c/triptych-summary

Meera: closing notes: include these as a short blurb in release notes for the next infra update.
